newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs seen fluctuating in wide range in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: JGBs seen fluctuating in wide range in Tokyo.

text.p: The key December Japanese government bond (JGB) futures contract is expected to continue volatile moves in Tokyo on Thursday, following a sharp correction on Wednesday.
If the Tokyo stock market reacts favourably to Wednesday's rally in the New York stock market and continues to rise sharply, JGBs could fall further, traders said.

"After two days of volatile moves, JGB futures are likely to continue to fluctuate in a wide range. If Tokyo stocks continue to rally, that should limit the upside potential of JGBs," said a trader at a city bank's securities unit.
